title: 纳斯卡新掌门谈赛车运动增长与年轻化
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Tyler and Steve, thank you so much for being here.
segments.zh: 泰勒、史蒂夫，非常感谢你们到来。

segments.en: I'm so excited to have you here. And I was just speaking with some of your team in the back saying, you know, I think more people are fans of NASCAR Motorsport than they think.
segments.zh: 非常高兴你们能来。我刚和你们团队的人聊过，我觉得喜欢纳斯卡赛车的人比大家以为的要多。

segments.en: They might be NASCAR curious. So my goal is that you come out of this conversation with more NASCAR fans that we had going in.
segments.zh: 他们可能对纳斯卡有点好奇。我的目标是，聊完之后，纳斯卡的粉丝比来之前更多。

segments.en: Our goals are aligned. Yeah, I love this. I just want to kick it off, Steve.
segments.zh: 我们的目标一致。太好了，我很喜欢。史蒂夫，我们就从你开始吧。

segments.en: You recently earlier this year became CEO of NASCAR.
segments.zh: 今年早些时候，你成为了纳斯卡的CEO。

segments.en: The first non-France family member ever to lead the sport.
segments.zh: 是首位非弗朗斯家族成员领导这项运动。

segments.en: But you're not, you're not new at all. You've been in NASCAR for 30 years.
segments.zh: 但你并不是新人，你在纳斯卡已经30年了。

segments.en: I'm curious just to know your mindset going into this new role.
segments.zh: 我很好奇，你担任这个新角色时的心态是怎样的。

segments.en: I also know your background. You have a baseball background.
segments.zh: 我也了解你的背景，你有棒球方面的经历。

segments.en: You come from other sports too. So how are you approaching now this new role at NASCAR?
segments.zh: 你也来自其他运动领域。那么你现在如何应对纳斯卡的这个新角色？

segments.en: What are the vulnerabilities and also the assets that you see?
segments.zh: 您认为哪些是薄弱环节，哪些又是优势？

segments.en: Yeah, I think if you look at NASCAR as a sport right now, we're really solid foundation on a growth spurt this year.
segments.zh: 嗯，我觉得现在看纳斯卡赛车，基础非常扎实，今年正处在增长期。

segments.en: But I think we would be really not taking advantage of the future if we kind of rested on our laurels and said, hey, we're seeing some metrics that are up.
segments.zh: 但如果我们固步自封，说指标在涨，那就没有把握未来。

segments.en: So the opportunity right now is to go around, talk to guys like Tyler, who are superstars in the sport, about we're going to put on a good race week by week.
segments.zh: 所以现在的机会是，和泰勒这样的明星车手聊聊，我们每周都会呈现精彩比赛。

segments.en: But where do we want to go five years from now? And what are the big things we can align on as a sport and really attack those?
segments.zh: 但五年后我们要走向哪里？哪些大事能让我们团结一致去攻克？
